clues.text: The Jebusites told David he would never get in, but he captured this fortress anyway.
Sitting by the rivers of Babylon, the exiles wept whenever they remembered this place.
Solomon gathered Israel's elders to bring the ark of the covenant up from here, the City of David.
John saw the Lamb standing on this mount with 144,000 who bore His Father's name.
When Jesus rode in on a donkey's colt, Matthew quoted a prophecy telling this place's Daughter her King was coming.
Peter wrote that God laid a chosen, precious cornerstone here, and believers in Him will never be shamed.
Isaiah foresaw many peoples going up to the Lord's mountain, for His law would go forth from here.
